prompts.lantern: Use case: stylized-concept. Generate a replacement production game prop for Katchimeras, not a UI mockup. Input image is the existing lantern to redesign: preserve its broad identity as a small leaf-roof Wisp home, but drastically simplify its material detail. One squat cozy toy-diorama 3D lantern with a large friendly rounded open arch, chunky cream and honey wooden-looking frame made of smooth molded clay, three or four broad sage-green roof leaves with almost no veins, softly bevelled edges, simple readable shapes, softly glowing amber interior, short broad circular foot that rests on a garden patch. Three-quarter isometric mobile-game camera slightly above, centered entire object with 10% transparent margin. Soft diffuse upper-left light, restrained contact shadow only, matte soft-plastic materials, low texture detail. No wood grain, no fine vines, no decorative carvings, no busy speckles, no text, no characters, no environment. Real transparent RGBA background. The object must read clearly at 100px. Square image.
prompts.pack: Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent mobile game asset for Katchimeras: ONE sealed collectible Wisp CARD PACK, recognizable trading-card booster wrapper silhouette, upright portrait rectangle with softly crimped top and bottom seams, gently rounded padded edges, slight three-quarter perspective showing a tiny right edge. Cozy toy-diorama 3D style, smooth molded soft-plastic/soft satin wrapper, very low texture detail, broad readable color blocks. Deep sage green body, warm cream-gold rounded edging and pale gold seam, large central raised emblem of a tiny rounded glowing amber Wisp flame with two small dot eyes, two simple embossed leaf shapes near bottom. Soft bevels and diffuse studio lighting, pleasing collectible treasure, no metallic photoreal wrinkles. Original art, do not copy any existing game branding. Entire pack centered with generous transparent margins, portrait canvas about 2:3. No text, no letters, no numbers, no extra cards, no hands, no background scene, no checkerboard; actual transparent RGBA. Reads at 120px.
prompts.frame: Use case: stylized-concept. Production Wisp collectible CARD FRAME asset for Katchimeras. ONE flat straight-on portrait card at exact 2:3 ratio, no perspective or tilt. Cozy toy-diorama 3D molded frame: soft rounded corners, broad cream-colored outer bevel with a fine honey-gold rim, subtle sage inner edge, low texture detail, no grain. Huge central EMPTY TRANSPARENT art window from 8% to 92% width and 16% to 72% height. Small blank cream header band from 5% to 14% height; generous blank cream nameplate from 75% to 92% height; a small simple inset oval blank medallion at bottom center for runtime rarity icon. Only two tiny softly sculpted sage leaves at opposite corners. Sophisticated simple geometry, soft diffuse light from upper left, very readable at mobile sizes. Frame fills canvas almost edge-to-edge with 2% margin. The exterior AND large central opening must be true transparent RGBA, not white or checkerboard. No character, no illustration inside, no scene, no text, no letters, no numbers, no stars. Original game asset, not a screenshot, single frame only.
prompts.dormant: Create a transparent-background mobile game sprite, single small unlit lantern, no scene. A cozy toy diorama 3D lantern house: squat cream rounded molded body, one large open rounded arch at front, sage-green roof made of four broad overlapping soft leaves, rounded honey-colored circular base and short feet, chunky curled wooden handle with a single dangling leaf. Empty unlit cream interior, no emitted glow. Smooth soft plastic, very low texture detail, no wood grain, no fine veins. Three-quarter front view slightly from above, object fully visible centered in square canvas, 10% margins, soft diffuse light from upper left. Background must be actually transparent with alpha channel. Isolated cutout. No text, no grid, no checkerboard, no environment, no extra objects.
